Rank 1 Melee Technique

  • Ki Cost: 5 Ki
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: Melee
  • Chargeable?: Yes
  • Duration: Instantaneous

A single target of your choice within range must make a Strength Saving Throw or take your Unarmed Strike Damage Die and being being Launched a total of 5x your Strength Modifier feet on a failure, half damage and no knockback on a success.

If the target is Launched into a solid structure they may break through it at half speed, taking 1d6 for each 5 feet they travel through it.
